job_description:
Senior Software Engineer, AI-Enabled CNO Tooling At Intelliforce, we build mission software that helps operators and developers move faster in environments where the work is complex and the stakes are real. In this role, you will support CNO development across multiple teams by designing, building, and integrating tools that improve how mission software gets developed, tested, and delivered. You will work closely with stakeholders and engineers to create new workflows enhanced by AI and ML technologies, helping solve real reverse engineering and development challenges in the field.

You will lead projects from concept through deployment, work directly with mission stakeholders, and help teams turn difficult operational problems into practical technical solutions. The work blends software engineering, workflow design, AI and ML integration, and close collaboration across the CNO developer space, so your impact is visible in both the tools you build and the teams you enable. Because we are a small business, leadership is accessible, communication is direct, and strong engineering gets noticed.

Add in long-term stability, strong benefits, and a people-first culture, and this becomes more than another senior software role. It is a chance to improve how mission teams build, test, and deliver software every day. Lead projects from inception to delivery in the CNO domain, including problem decomposition, design, development, deployment, and maintenance Collaborate with software engineers to test workflows, identify issues, and recommend clear paths to resolution Apply AI and ML technologies to improve workflows and create smarter development solutions Help guide technical direction across complex efforts and work through obstacles as they arise Clearance: Top Secret Clearance with Full Scope Polygraph, must be active.

S. Citizen. We cannot sponsor visas 12 years of relevant experience with a Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline Four additional years of relevant experience may be substituted in place of a Bachelor’s degree Production-grade software development experience in Python Experience in the CNO developer domain building tools for operational use Experience with development of AI systems and customization of AI models Practical experience with platforms for processing Agency data sets Experience with software source control, including Git Knowledge of Python or similar scripting languages Practical experience in one or more artificial intelligence domains such as intelligent systems, autonomy, planning, LLMs, or LLM training Knowledge of end-to-end SIGINT collection and analysis systems Experience with production CNO capabilities and operations Familiarity with cloud computing technologies such as AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes Experience with web application or UI development

As a Systems Engineer here, you won’t just contribute to projects—you’ll help shape outcomes that make a real-world impact.

Ample PTO to rest and recharge—plus all federal holidays and your birthday off, just because. Multiple medical plan options, including ones with zero deductible or premium for employees. Generous 401(k) with immediate vesting—because your future matters now.

Exciting bonus opportunities, from profit sharing to quarterly awards and President’s Club recognition. Intelliforce-IT Solutions Group, LLC is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. Need accommodations during the application process?

We’re happy to help.
